posts.cooked:
Hey gang!

So I may be missing this somewhere, but do we know who the silhouettes on "Old Tricks--New Allies" in Vengeance Baron Blade's deck are? They aren't the Vengeful Five, that's for sure. Looking at the silhouette, I'd guess that the two on the right are Tantrum and Argentium, and I think the one on the far left may be Choke, but I can't seem to find confirmation anywhere, and have no real clue as to who the two others are (or even where the tentacles are coming from). Anyone have any guesses on this?

Also, in case the news hasn't reached this thread yet--the big red dude with the cross on his chest in Tempest's "Flash Flood" and Sentinels' "Coordinated Assault" is Borr the Unstable.
